_notes: OddsPapi allows at most 5 leagues per request, so extra leagues are split across requests automatically. combine_sports packs leagues from all sports together, 5 per request. compare_book is the stand-in for the book you bet at: its prices times the factor give the estimated price at your_book_label. compare_by_sport holds what --compare-books measured for each sport (factor, and spread_pct = how far apart the two books' prices typically are). compare_default is a placeholder for sports not measured yet. sharp_extra_books lists more sharp books to average with Pinnacle for the true probability; each one costs 1 extra request per group of leagues, so test a book first with --check-sharp, then add its name, e.g. ["singbet"]. The --live run warns you if the spread signs look reversed.
